justification: A public-site and serving change: every menu points at Council Rules and Site Facts only, pricing shows no prices, /assessment shows a notice outside the ten pilot councils, and the controls table now receives the site zone

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A navigation file links outside the two products, the pricing page shows a price, a pilot-unlisted page reaches a sitemap, an address outside the ten councils counts as in the pilot, or the controls route stops passing the zone to the guarded source
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the allowed-link exemptions were added the pilot link test failed on the reports page (2 links) and the old hidden-products and product-names tests failed (7 and 3 entries); the zone tests assert the call arguments, so dropping the zone argument fails 3 of the 4 new route tests

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads shared/brief-scope.json for the ten councils and calls the existing /pipeline/dcp-controls endpoint, which already accepted a zone; no table is written
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If the portal zone label has no readable code, no zone filter is applied and every row shows as before; the response reports zone_filter_applied null
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every page view after deploy; old pages stay reachable by URL, unlinked and noindex
pre_impl.frontend_type: DcpStructuredControls gains an optional zone prop; the route response gains zone_filter_applied
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A visitor outside the ten councils sees a plain pilot notice listing the councils instead of rules we have not measured, and the property facts on the left still load

functions.name: zoneCode
functions.input: a portal zone label such as R2 Low Density Residential
functions.output: the bare zone code or null
functions.if_none: null means no zone filter, never a guess

functions.name: isPilotUnlisted
functions.input: a path or a full URL string
functions.output: true when the page is withdrawn from navigation and search for the pilot

functions.name: isPilotCouncil
functions.input: the former-council slug and the LGA name
functions.output: true only for a council named in the scope file
functions.if_none: missing or unknown council returns false, so the pilot notice shows

functions.name: GET
functions.input: council, dev_type and an optional zone
functions.output: grouped controls plus the zone filter that was applied
functions.if_none: no zone means no filter and zone_filter_applied null

functions.name: pilotCouncilKey
functions.input: the former-council slug and the LGA name of an address
functions.output: the first of the two that is a pilot council, or null
functions.if_none: a missing or unknown council returns null and the pilot notice shows

functions.name: isPilotZone
functions.input: the zone label the portal gives for the site
functions.output: true only when the label reads as the zone the clauses were measured for
functions.if_none: a missing or unreadable zone returns false and the notice says the zone could not be read

values.if_missing: no filter is applied and the response says so
the address is treated as outside the pilot and the notice shows
the page shows the notice that the zone could not be read and no rules

break_it.scenario: The portal returns a zone label with no leading code
break_it.what_happens: No zone filter is applied and every row for the project type shows
break_it.how: Unreadable zone gives null and the response reports zone_filter_applied null; the backend filter keeps a row when in doubt

break_it.scenario: An address in Inner West outside Ashfield
break_it.what_happens: It is treated as outside the pilot and shows the pilot notice
break_it.how: isPilotCouncil keys on the former-council slug first

break_it.scenario: A new page links to an old tool from a menu
break_it.what_happens: The link test fails and CI blocks the change
break_it.how: The navigation files are scanned for any href outside the allowed list

break_it.scenario: A blog post still links to an old tool
break_it.what_happens: Anyone who opens that post by URL can follow the link
break_it.how: Known limit: the blog is unlinked and noindex but its 39 posts are not edited

break_it.scenario: Site Facts still shows a setback figure that feeds its yield estimate
break_it.what_happens: It can differ from the Council Rules table for the same address
break_it.how: Not changed here; the yield estimate uses DCP setbacks and needs an owner decision
break_it.repro: compare the DCP setbacks row in Site Facts with the Council Rules table for one address

break_it.scenario: A Hornsby address in zone R3
break_it.what_happens: The page shows the pilot notice naming the zone and no rules
break_it.how: The gate requires the council and the pilot zone

break_it.scenario: A Northern Beaches address carries an old former-council name
break_it.what_happens: It is still found as a pilot council through its current council name
break_it.how: pilotCouncilKey tries both keys and the page sends the pilot key to the data calls

post_merge.manual_verify: Open the homepage, then an address in Hornsby and one in Campbelltown on /assessment: the first shows rules, the second shows the pilot notice
